items.definition:
easily nauseated or disgusted
She's a bit squeamish about blood, so she avoids horror movies.

without help or assistance
She managed to complete the complex puzzle unaided.

not achieved or brought into being
He had many unrealized ambitions from his youth.

not practical or able to be implemented
The proposed plan was deemed unworkable due to budget constraints.

of or involving two races
She identifies as biracial, with both African and European heritage.

irritability or quarrelsome; prone to making small, sharp remarks
He was feeling a bit chippy after losing the game.

lacking social class distinctions; vulgar or unsophisticated
His rude remarks were considered classless by many.

befitting a gentleman; polite and honorable
He always behaved in a gentlemanly manner.

resembling leather in being tough and flexible
His skin was leathery from years of sun exposure.

close; immediate
The proximate cause of the accident was a faulty brake.

nauseous; uneasy
The boat ride made her feel a bit queasy.

conservative or reactionary in political outlook
The right-wing party won the election by a narrow margin.

made of or resembling silk
She wore a dress of silken fabric.

like a sponge; soft and absorbent
The cake had a light and spongy texture.

sensitive to tickling; requiring careful handling
My feet are very ticklish.

not persuaded or certain
Despite his arguments, I remained unconvinced.

impossible to dispute or question
Her dedication to the project was unquestionable.

strange or unconventional
The plot of the movie was truly bizarro.

Relating to capitalism
The country has a largely capitalistic economy.

without a father
The child grew up fatherless after the war.

emotional; sensitive to touch
She's a very feely person, always hugging everyone.

dazed, weak, or unsteady, especially from illness, sleep, or a blow
I felt groggy after only three hours of sleep.

not physically or mentally strong, especially through age or illness
The old man was too infirm to walk without assistance.

extremely small
The chances of success were minuscule.

designed for multiple families
They are building a new multifamily housing complex.

having resistance; opposing
The material is highly resistive to heat.

resembling rubber in texture or elasticity
The old elastic band felt rubbery and stretched easily.

lacking imagination or foresight; nearsighted
His shortsighted decision led to long-term problems.

very bad or unpleasant
That was a really sucky movie.

not likely to be appreciated or rewarded
Being a teacher can sometimes be a thankless job.

not attractive or interesting
The food looked unappealing.

not having a high level of social or cultural development
Some ancient cultures were considered uncivilized by their contemporaries.

not showing or feeling patriotism
Some people considered his actions unpatriotic.

able to be seen
The document is now viewable online.

opposed to war
She participated in an antiwar protest.

occurring every two months or twice a month
The magazine is published bimonthly.

feeling or showing distrust of someone or something
She became distrustful of strangers after the incident.

soft and fluffy
The baby bird had soft, downy feathers.

without fault or defect; perfect
Her performance was absolutely faultless.

suitable for injection
The doctor prescribed an injectable medication.

dark or black like ink
The night sky was an inky black.

relating to Malaya/Malaysia
The Malayan tiger is an endangered species.

not following or conforming to tradition
She pursued a nontraditional career path.

filled with remorse; regretful
He felt deeply remorseful for the pain he had caused.

traveling by sea
His grandfather had a long and distinguished seafaring career.

not able to be excused or defended
His actions were completely unjustifiable.

suitable for walking
The city center is very walkable, with many pedestrian streets.

unprofessional; not skillful
The performance was quite amateurish, lacking polish.

inflamed and red, especially of the eyes
After a sleepless night, his eyes were bloodshot.

relating to a Caesarean section
She had a caesarean birth for her second child.

resembling a cartoon; exaggerated or simplistic
The character had a cartoonish grin.

relating to a Cesarean section
She recovered quickly from her cesarean delivery.

not showing a serious or respectful attitude
His flippant remark about the serious situation angered many.

not belonging to or supported by a government
Many nongovernmental organizations provide aid to developing countries.

derogatory or mocking in an indirect way
She made a snide remark about his new haircut.

showing sensitivity in dealing with others
He gave a tactful response to avoid offending anyone.

smaller than the usual or desired size
The undersized puppy struggled to keep up with its siblings.

having too few employees
The hospital ward was severely understaffed during the night shift.

unable to be explained or accounted for
There was an unexplainable chill in the air.

not changed or altered in form or character
The original text remained unmodified after the review.

not having undergone a process to alter or preserve it
Eating unprocessed foods is generally healthier.

providing help or support
Assistive technology helps people with disabilities.

very dry (wine, especially champagne)
We celebrated with a bottle of brut champagne.

Liable to be charged or debited.
Any extra services will be chargeable to your room.
